# RFC 11 example records

Copied unchanged from `schemas/rfc11/examples/` in
[copperheadhq/copperhead-rfcs](https://github.com/copperheadhq/copperhead-rfcs),
as adopted with RFC 11 version 1.4 (pull request #15, merged as `8c91020`). They cite one another by content hash,
so `test/pcb-ir.test.ts` uses them as conformance fixtures. fang uses the same
records for its own encoder. Do not edit them by hand.
